name: PaidHR
description:
PaidHR is the full-suite HRMS that unifies HR, payroll, time & attendance, performance and financial wellness in one platform — giving African enterprises total control of people operations, and their employees real financial wellbeing.

WHO WE SERVE
For fast-growing and enterprise organizations across Africa that need to run people operations without stitching together disconnected tools.

PaidHR unifies the entire employee lifecycle — HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, performance management and embedded financial wellness — in one compliant platform.

Unlike fragmented point tools and legacy systems, PaidHR adapts natively to existing workflows and gives employees self-service visibility and control over their work and their money.

WHY PAIDHR
🟦 One complete suite Core HR, performance management and geo-referenced time & attendance — not just payroll. ₦47.2bn processed in 2025, rising to ₦119.2bn year-to-date in 2026. 400+ businesses · 25,000+ employees · 49 currencies.

🟨 Enterprise scale & compliance 49-currency payroll, multi-entity support and automated statutory filing. ₦934M PAYE and ₦754M pension remitted in 2025 with zero defaults and zero delays. ISO 27001 certified.

🟩 PaidLife wellbeing Earned wage access, loans, bill payments, payslips and a wallet for every employee. ₦650M disbursed with zero non-performing loans, and ₦8bn in employer-backed loans processed in 2025.

ABOUT US
Founded in 2021 and backed by an Accion Venture Lab–led seed round, PaidHR serves 400+ businesses and 25,000+ employees across Africa.

Book a demo: paidhr.com/book-demo
slogan: One platform HRMS for fast-growing African enterprises and employee financial wellness.
